title: Wire commit_bead_state through make_services()
description: In src/agent_takt/cli/services.py make_services() (services.py:63): ensure config is loaded before RepositoryStorage is constructed, then pass commit_bead_state=config.common.commit_bead_state into the RepositoryStorage constructor. The argument order change (config before storage) is local to this function; no external callers change. Direct RepositoryStorage(root) constructions in tests remain valid because the new kwarg is optional.
acceptance_criteria: The RepositoryStorage instance returned by make_services() has commit_bead_state matching the loaded config value
No test files that construct RepositoryStorage(root) directly are modified
